# Restore Record

## Summary
The way back from Archive Record: returns a record to the working set by writing `recordStatus` to Active, legality checked against the Record Status transition graph. The pair are separate commands on purpose — a consumer surfaces Archive on live records and Restore on archived ones, and no call site carries a "which direction?" argument. Same safety rails as its sibling: re-fetch before read, idempotent on an already-active record.

## Usage
```ts
import RestoreRecordCommand from './restore-record';

await new RestoreRecordCommand(commandContext).execute({ card: quest } as any);
```
First consumer lands with Quest Log stage 2 (un-archiving a quest from the archived view).

## Non-goals
Everything Archive Record excludes: no query filtering, no hard-delete recovery, no domain-status changes. Restoring a record says nothing about where its domain lifecycle left off — that field was never touched.
